title: W14 managed publication requires a separately enrolled Jarvis publisher

conditions.description: Provide the enrolled isolated publisher device ID and read-only proof of its canonical Jarvis binding. It must run a source-attested accepted trusted-writer build from b6559a27afcee954bad73772f2fd9c1db7ced117 lineage, use distinct configuration/data, OAuth and effect state, and preserve the serving client connection. The connected Kruso device does not currently resolve the canonical Jarvis checkout. Integrator verifies the binding and exclusive W14 effect ownership, then reconciles exact remote refs, journals and receipt identities before acting on the existing conditional publication authorization. Keep W14 publication held until these prerequisites are met.
